name: Gilshalan Windwalker
summary: At Aldrassil's roots in Shadowglen, Gilshalan Windwalker studies the corruption spreading through Teldrassil. He begins with the Webwood spiders and their growing aggression.

sections.title: A Scholar at the Roots
sections.body: From the stone steps at Aldrassil's entrance, Gilshalan Windwalker watches over Shadowglen. Teldrassil was planted to restore the night elves' lost sanctuary and their harmony with nature. Yet signs of spiritual malaise appeared almost at once. Gilshalan studies how the corruption affects local beasts, beginning with the venomous spiders weaving webs nearby.

sections.title: The Webwood Menace
sections.body: North of Shadowglen, Gilshalan studies the Webwood spiders in Shadowthread Cave. Once part of the forest's balance, they have grown hostile and tainted. He sends young novices to gather venom sacs and intact eggs. Through these, he hopes to learn how the venom has changed and whether the corruption passes through generations or spreads from Teldrassil's soil.

sections.title: Word to the Archdruid
sections.body: Gilshalan believes the Webwood spiders' venom may bear signs of the new World Tree's recent growth. He arranges to send venom and an egg to Darnassus, where he will continue his studies. He also tells promising protectors that Tenaron Stormgrip seeks them in Aldrassil's highest room. There, the druidic leadership watches over the young World Tree.

faq.answer: At Aldrassil in Shadowglen, Gilshalan Windwalker studies the wildlife. The night elf scholar investigates the corruption affecting Teldrassil's creatures.

faq.q: Why does Gilshalan want Webwood venom?
faq.answer: Gilshalan wants Webwood venom to learn how it has changed and why the spiders have grown so aggressive and tainted.

faq.q: What does he do with the Webwood egg?
faq.answer: Gilshalan sends the Webwood egg to Darnassus with the venom so he can study both specimens there. An unhatched egg is easier to transport than a grown giant spider, which is too dangerous to capture.

faq.q: Where does Gilshalan send adventurers next?
aliases: who do i see after gilshalan
faq.answer: Gilshalan sends adventurers to Aldrassil's highest room, where Tenaron Stormgrip seeks them.
Gilshalan Windwalker sits on the stone pathway at Aldrassil's northern base in Shadowglen, outside the hollow entrance to the central tree.

faq.q: Why is the wildlife in Teldrassil aggressive?
faq.answer: The cause of Teldrassil's aggressive wildlife is unknown. A blight seeping through the tree's roots and soil corrupts the creatures' minds and nature, worrying residents like Gilshalan.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see Gilshalan's early effort to understand why violent, afflicted wildlife already lives around the young World Tree.
As a druid, you see how Gilshalan's research helps the Cenarion Circle diagnose the ecological imbalance in Shadowglen's boughs.
